aboutGame.title: What is Tenebris Somnia?
paragraphs: Tenebris Somnia is a retro 2D survival horror adventure from Argentine studio Saibot Studios, co-created by Andrés Borghi and Tobías Rusjan and published by New Blood Interactive. You play as Julia, a woman whose nightmares follow her into the waking world: after visiting her missing ex-boyfriend, she slips into a parallel universe where monsters hunt her through pixel-art rooms, item-combination puzzles, and limited-resource combat.

What sets Tenebris Somnia apart is its presentation split. At key story beats the pixel art cuts away to live-action sequences shot by an award-winning Argentine film crew using real actors, real sets, and practical effects. The game launches on October 16, 2026 for Windows PC on Steam, is Steam Deck Verified, and already has a free playable demo that covers the opening house and its red door puzzle.

faq.title: Tenebris Somnia FAQ
faq.description: Quick answers to the most common questions about Tenebris Somnia, from the red door puzzle to the release date.

items.question: What is Tenebris Somnia?
items.answer: Tenebris Somnia is a retro 2D survival horror adventure from Argentine studio Saibot Studios, co-created by Andrés Borghi and Tobías Rusjan and published by New Blood Interactive. You play as Julia, who searches for her missing ex-boyfriend and falls into a parallel universe where monsters hunt her.

items.question: When does Tenebris Somnia release?
items.answer: Tenebris Somnia launches on October 16, 2026 on Steam for Windows PC at $24.99, with a 20 percent launch discount to $19.99. It is Steam Deck Verified and a free demo is already available.

items.question: How do I solve the red door puzzle in Tenebris Somnia?
items.answer: The red door needs a chemical, a source of light, and iron. Fill the glass with the chemical, pry the lowest board off the bedroom window with the wrench to let sunlight in, then use the chemical on the bloodstain on the bathroom mirror, because the blood is your iron, and apply the mixture to the door.

items.question: Is there a Tenebris Somnia demo?
items.answer: Yes. A free demo is available on the Tenebris Somnia Steam store page and covers the opening house, the red door puzzle, and the floor symbol riddle. It is a compact slice that teaches the inventory and item-combination systems.

items.question: Does Tenebris Somnia have multiplayer or co-op?
items.answer: No. Tenebris Somnia is a single-player survival horror game built around isolation, and no co-op or multiplayer modes have been announced.

items.question: Which platforms can I play Tenebris Somnia on?
items.answer: Tenebris Somnia is a PC-first release available on Steam for Windows, and it is Steam Deck Verified, so it runs out of the box on Valve's handheld.
